The artifact score is adjusted to reflect these minor textural imperfections rather than catastrophic failures.
alignment_reasoning: The Fine-Grained Classifier strongly confirms the class 'meat loaf' (Rank 1, high logit). The deviation in sauce color (gravy vs ketchup) and form (slice vs loaf) prevents a perfect 5.0, but the semantic alignment is very high.
